encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ἔφα τις ὡς ἐν ἅλμῃ θερμῇ
τοῦτο φάγοι γ’ ἑφθὸν ἀνὴρ Μοσχίων φίλαυλος.
βοᾷ δ’ ὄνειδος ἴδιον, ὦ Καλαίδη·
σὺ μὲν ἀμφὶ σῦκα καὶ ἀμφὶ τάριχ’ ἀγάλλει,
τοῦ δ’ ἐν ἅλμῃ παρεόντος οὐ γεύει χαρίεντος ὄψου.

ceterum permirum est quomodo Athenaeus his versibus demonstrari posse crediderit Calliam fuisse aleatorem. nam Meinekii quidem ratio verbo κυβεύειν luxuriosam vitam significari censentis admitti nullo modo potest, cum Athenaeus eum πρὸς τῷ ὀψοφαγεῖν καὶ κυβεύειν dicat. sed omnes in hac ecloga et emendandi et interpretandi conatus, cum praesertim ne de metro quidem constet, nihil aliud sunt quam desperationis indicia.
